symbols.name: EventMap
symbols.description: Native events dispatched through `Events.on`. Each property is the exact callback argument tuple for that event.

properties.name: resourceStart
properties.description: Dispatched after a resource entry point has run and immediately before the resource becomes running.

properties.name: resourceStop
properties.description: Dispatched while a resource is stopping, before its stop callback, timers, exports and event handlers are cleaned up.

properties.name: consoleCommand
properties.description: Dispatched after the server console parses a command line that no built-in command handles.

properties.name: missionChange
properties.description: Dispatched after World.changeMission has reset the world and asked every client to load the new mission.

properties.name: missionReady
properties.description: Dispatched once each time every connected player has loaded the current mission generation. At least one player must be connected.

properties.name: playerMissionReady
properties.description: Dispatched when a player's client has loaded the current mission.

properties.name: playerMissionUnloaded
properties.description: Dispatched when a player's client has unloaded its mission.

properties.name: playerMissionLoadFailed
properties.description: Dispatched when a player's client could not load the current mission.

properties.name: playerConnect
properties.description: Dispatched after a player has connected and has a player handle. The player is not spawned yet.

properties.name: playerDisconnect
properties.description: Dispatched while a player disconnects, before the player handle stops resolving.

properties.name: playerVoiceStart
properties.description: Dispatched when a player starts speaking on voice chat, including when no one is in earshot.

properties.name: playerVoiceStop
properties.description: Dispatched shortly after a player's last voice frame reaches the server. A disconnect ends speech without this event.

properties.name: playerChat
properties.description: Dispatched for an accepted, sanitized chat line after it was relayed.

properties.name: playerCommand
properties.description: Dispatched when a chat line starting with `/` passes the chat rate limit.

properties.name: playerNicknameChange
properties.description: Dispatched after Player.setNickname changed the name.

properties.name: playerModelChange
properties.description: Dispatched after Player.setModel changed the human model.

properties.name: playerMoneyChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the server changes a player's Free Ride balance.

properties.name: doorStateChange
properties.description: Dispatched after a player uses a mission door or a script changes its open target. Player is null for script changes.

properties.name: doorLockChange
properties.description: Dispatched after a script changes a mission door lock.

properties.name: doorInteractionChange
properties.description: Dispatched after a script enables or disables native door use.

properties.name: playerSpawn
properties.description: Dispatched after Player.spawn started a new life.

properties.name: playerRespawn
properties.description: Dispatched after Player.respawn started a new life.

properties.name: playerDespawn
properties.description: Dispatched after Player.despawn ended the current life.

properties.name: playerDamage
properties.description: Dispatched after an accepted health decrease.

properties.name: playerDeath
properties.description: Dispatched after a fatal health decrease, following playerDamage. The killer is null when no connected attacker owns the damage; info.weaponId identifies the validated weapon when known. Death never respawns a player by itself; call Player.respawn.

type.name: [victim: Player, killer: Player | null, info: PlayerHealthInfo]

properties.name: playerHealthChange
properties.description: Dispatched after an accepted health increase.

properties.name: playerWeaponEquip
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerAimChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponReload
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponFire
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponThrow
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponThrowStart
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponThrowRelease
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponThrowCancel
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponMeleeStart
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponMelee
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponMeleeCancel
properties.description: Dispatched after the server accepted this controller action.

properties.name: playerWeaponDrop
properties.description: Dispatched after a controller drop or Player.dropWeapon updates inventory. Death drops only emit weaponDropped.

properties.name: weaponDropped
properties.description: Dispatched when a drop or a death leaves a weapon pickup in the world.

type.name: [pickup: Pickup | null, player: Player | null, info: PickupEventInfo]

properties.name: pickupTaken
properties.description: Dispatched after the server moved a pickup into a player's inventory. The pickup handle is null when nothing is left on the ground.

type.name: [pickup: Pickup | null, player: Player | null, info: PickupEventInfo]

properties.name: vehicleSpawn
properties.description: Dispatched after Vehicle.spawn created a vehicle.

properties.name: vehicleDestroy
properties.description: Dispatched immediately before Vehicle.destroy removes the vehicle. A mission change removes every vehicle without this event.

properties.name: vehicleEngineChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleFuelChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleLightsChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleHornChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleSirenChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleGearChange
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleDamageState
properties.description: Dispatched after the matching vehicle state changed, from its simulation controller or a script.

properties.name: vehicleDamage
properties.description: Dispatched when the native per-part damage snapshot changes.

properties.name: vehicleOpacityChange
properties.description: Dispatched after Vehicle.setOpacity changes the server-owned opacity.

properties.name: vehicleRepair
properties.description: Dispatched after Vehicle.repair starts a native damage and deformation reset on every client; a fresh damage snapshot follows from the simulation controller.

properties.name: vehicleTerminal
properties.description: Dispatched when a vehicle explodes (1), its native body hits water (2), or it enters a fall volume or native invalid-fall state (3). Water and fall occupants die through server combat immediately after this event; explosion occupants die before it. Scripts decide when to destroy the car.

properties.name: vehicleHit
properties.description: Dispatched when a pellet hit is replayed to the vehicle's simulation controller, before the resulting vehicleDamage.

properties.name: vehiclePartDetached
properties.description: Dispatched when the server accepts a native loose part from the vehicle's controller.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerEntering
properties.description: Dispatched when the server accepts the start of a native enter or steal.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerEntered
properties.description: Dispatched when a player sits in a seat, natively or through Player.putInVehicle.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerExited
properties.description: Dispatched when a player leaves a seat, including by death, respawn or removeFromVehicle.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerExitBlocked
properties.description: Dispatched when a script records an administrative blocked exit; native blocked exits use seat transfer or the retail emergency exit.

properties.name: vehiclePlayerSeatChanged
properties.description: Dispatched after a blocked-side exit moves the player into the paired seat. info.fromSeat is the prior seat.

properties.name: entityStateChange
properties.description: Dispatched when one key of an entity's state changes: on the server when a script writes it, on a client when the write arrives. `value` is undefined when the key was removed and `previous` is undefined when it held nothing before, so a stored null stays distinguishable from an absent key. The entity is whatever the game's WrapScriptEntity answers, and the base Entity handle by default.

type.name: [entity: Entity, key: string, value: any, previous: any]

properties.name: mission

properties.name: missionGeneration

properties.description: Generation the report refers to.

properties.name: state

symbols.name: PlayerHealthInfo
symbols.description: An accepted change of a player's server health.

properties.name: attacker
properties.description: Player the damage is attributed to, or null when the source is absent or has disconnected.

properties.name: weaponId
properties.description: Validated weapon used for this damage: 0 is fists, 5 is a Molotov, 15 is a grenade; null for script, fall, vehicle or unknown damage. Remains known if the attacker disconnects after throwing.

properties.name: cause
properties.description: Server damage path that changed health. Explosions and fires can have a weaponId when they came from a thrown weapon.

properties.name: oldHealth
properties.description: Health before the change.

properties.name: health
properties.description: Health after the change.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: oldHealth minus health; negative for healing.

properties.name: deathAnimation
properties.description: Death animation chosen by the server for a fatal change, otherwise 0.

properties.name: missionGeneration
properties.description: Mission generation of the affected life.

properties.name: spawnGeneration
properties.description: Spawn generation of the affected life.

symbols.name: WeaponActionInfo
symbols.description: A weapon action the server accepted from a player's client.

properties.name: weaponId
properties.description: Weapon the action used.

properties.name: selectedWeapon
properties.description: Selected weapon after the action; 0 is holstered.

properties.name: inventoryMask
properties.description: Bit n is set when weapon n is held.

properties.name: loaded
properties.description: Loaded ammunition of weaponId after the action.

properties.name: reserve
properties.description: Reserve ammunition of weaponId after the action.

properties.name: aiming
properties.description: Whether the player is aiming.

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Unit aim or throw direction.

type.name: { x: number; y: number; z: number }

properties.name: target
properties.description: The targeted player the client suggested for a shot; confirmed damage arrives as playerDamage.

properties.name: revision
properties.description: Server combat state revision.

properties.name: meleeIndex
properties.description: Native combo index (0 to 3), or -1 for a heavy finisher on a melee release.

properties.name: meleeHoldMs
properties.description: Measured local press duration on a melee release, in milliseconds.

properties.name: throwHoldMs
properties.description: Native grenade or Molotov charge duration on a throw release, capped at 2000 milliseconds; zero for other actions.

symbols.name: PickupEventInfo
symbols.description: A weapon pickup transition.

properties.name: pickupId
properties.description: Network ID of the pickup, which may no longer exist.

properties.name: weaponId
properties.description: Weapon of the pickup.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Where the pickup lies, or null once it is gone.

type.name: { x: number; y: number; z: number } | null

properties.name: shooter

properties.name: damage
properties.description: Damage derived from the accepted shot.

properties.name: position
properties.description: World-space impact position.

type.name: { x: number; y: number; z: number }

properties.name: shotSequence
properties.description: Shooter's fire sequence.

properties.name: pelletIndex
properties.description: Pellet of that shot.

symbols.description: A loose part a vehicle shed.

properties.name: debrisId
properties.description: Network ID of the temporary debris replica.

properties.name: type
properties.description: 1 wheel, 2 bumper, 3 light, 4 license plate, 5 mirror, 6 wing, 7 door.

properties.name: partIndex
properties.description: Native part index within the model.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Where the part came off.

type.name: { x: number; y: number; z: number }

symbols.name: Player
symbols.description: A connected Mafia 1 player. The server owns its life, health, inventory and seat; every change goes through server validation and replicates to all clients.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a handle for an existing connected player; it does not create a player.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this player for logging.

returns.description: The player ID and nickname.

functions.name: kick
functions.description: Disconnects this player.

functions.name: emit
functions.description: Emits a named script event to this player's client.

parameters.name: payloadJson
parameters.description: JSON payload forwarded to the client.

functions.name: getIP
functions.description: Returns this player's remote network address.

returns.description: Address, or an empty string when unavailable.

functions.name: setNickname
functions.description: Applies the nickname policy: invalid characters are removed, whitespace collapsed, the name cut to 24 characters, and a taken name gets a numbered suffix. Fires playerNicknameChange when the name changes.

returns.description: The nickname actually used, or null when the player has left.

functions.name: setModel
functions.description: Selects this player's human model on every client, including during a life. The choice persists across respawns and mission changes. Fires playerModelChange when it changes.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Stock human .i3d filename, 5 to 64 ASCII characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, dash, or dot.

returns.description: False for an invalid filename or a disconnected player.

functions.name: setNametag
functions.description: Changes this player's nametag.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Only the given fields change. color is 0xRRGGBB and also colors the name in chat; an empty text restores the nickname.

type.name: { visible?: boolean; showHealth?: boolean; color?: number; text?: string }

returns.description: False when the player has left.

functions.name: setNametagVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides this player's nametag.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: Whether other players see this player's name.

functions.name: setNametagHealthVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides the health bar under this player's name.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: Whether the health bar is shown.

functions.name: setNametagText
functions.description: Overrides this player's nametag label.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Label to show instead of the nickname; empty restores it.

functions.name: setNametagColor
functions.description: Tints this player's nametag and chat name.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Packed 0xAARRGGBB or 0xRRGGBB color; the alpha is always opaque.

functions.name: sendMessage
functions.description: Sends a private chat notice to this player.

returns.description: False when the player has left or the text is invalid.

functions.name: spawn
functions.description: Starts a new life with 100 health and an empty inventory once every client is mission ready. A seat held by the previous life is released and recorded as an exit. Fires playerSpawn.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Spawn position; three numbers x, y, z are accepted too.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

parameters.name: heading
parameters.description: Facing in radians around the vertical axis; defaults to 0.

returns.description: False before every client is ready, for an invalid position, or when the player has left.

functions.name: respawn
functions.description: Starts a new life after death, like spawn. The server never respawns anyone by itself. Fires playerRespawn.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Spawn position; three numbers x, y, z are accepted too.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

returns.description: False when the life could not be started.

functions.name: despawn
functions.description: Ends the current life and clears its seat. Fires playerDespawn.

returns.description: False when the player has left.

functions.name: getSuggestedSpawn
functions.description: Returns the native scene spawn hint the player's client reported for the current mission.

returns.description: The hint, or null before the client reported one.

functions.name: setHealth
functions.description: Sets server health, firing playerDamage, playerDeath or playerHealthChange. A dead player cannot be revived this way; use respawn.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: Health from 0 to 100; values outside are clamped.

returns.description: False when there is no living, spawned player.

functions.name: setMoney
functions.description: Sets this player's server balance. Fires playerMoneyChange when it changes.

returns.description: False if the player has disconnected.

functions.name: giveMoney
functions.description: Adds or removes money without exceeding the balance bounds. Fires playerMoneyChange when it changes.

returns.description: False if the result would be negative or above the maximum, or the player has disconnected.

functions.name: trySpendMoney
functions.description: Atomically checks and debits this player's server balance. Use the return value to grant shop goods. Fires playerMoneyChange on a nonzero purchase.

returns.description: False if the player cannot afford the cost or has disconnected.

functions.name: getVehicle
functions.description: Returns the vehicle whose seat the current life holds.

returns.description: The vehicle, or null on foot.

functions.name: getCameraTarget
functions.description: Returns the player this client's camera follows when scripted, or null for the local camera.

returns.description: The connected target, or null.

functions.name: setCameraTarget
functions.description: Makes this player's camera follow the target on foot and switch to the target's car while seated. The choice persists across both players' respawns; a missing or despawned target temporarily falls back to the observer.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Connected player to follow, or null to restore the local camera.

returns.description: False when the observer has left or the target is not connected in the same mission.

functions.name: getSeat
functions.description: Returns the seat the current life holds; 0 is the driver.

returns.description: The seat, or null on foot.

functions.name: putInVehicle
functions.description: Records the player as seated through the server seat path, as if the native entry had completed; it does not play the door animation. Seat 0 makes this player's client the vehicle's simulation controller. Fires vehiclePlayerEntered.

parameters.name: vehicle
parameters.description: Vehicle to seat the player in.

returns.description: False for a dead or unspawned player, another mission's vehicle, or a seat that is taken or out of range.

functions.name: removeFromVehicle
functions.description: Records the player's current seat as exited without the native exit animation. Fires vehiclePlayerExited.

returns.description: False when the player is not seated.

functions.name: giveWeapon
functions.description: Grants a weapon to a living player.

parameters.name: loaded
parameters.description: Loaded rounds, or the throwable count; defaults to a full magazine for a firearm and 1 otherwise. A firearm is capped to its magazine.

returns.description: False for a dead player, an unsupported weapon or a full inventory.

functions.name: giveAmmo
functions.description: Adds reserve ammunition to a held weapon.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Reserve delta; a negative amount removes ammunition down to zero.

returns.description: False when the weapon is not held.

functions.name: setWeaponAmmo
functions.description: Sets the ammunition of a held weapon; it does not grant the weapon.

parameters.name: loaded
parameters.description: Loaded rounds; a firearm is capped to its magazine.

returns.description: False when the weapon is not held.

functions.name: removeWeapon
functions.description: Removes a held weapon.

returns.description: False when it was not held.

functions.name: dropWeapon
functions.description: Moves a held weapon and its ammunition into a replicated pickup at the player's feet. Fires weaponDropped and playerWeaponDrop.

parameters.name: weaponId
parameters.description: Held weapon to drop; defaults to the selected weapon.

returns.description: The new pickup, or null if the player is dead, unspawned, seated, has no selected weapon, does not hold the requested weapon, or the pickup limit is full.

functions.name: removeAllWeapons
functions.description: Holsters and removes every weapon of a living player.

returns.description: False for a dead or unspawned player.

functions.name: setCurrentWeapon
functions.description: Selects a held weapon.

parameters.name: weaponId
parameters.description: A held weapon, or 0 to holster.

returns.description: False when the weapon is not held.

functions.name: getCurrentWeapon
functions.description: Returns the selected weapon.

returns.description: The weapon ID, 0 when holstered or not spawned.

functions.name: hasWeapon
functions.description: Checks whether the current life holds a weapon.

returns.description: True when it is held.

functions.name: getWeapons
functions.description: Lists the held weapons with their ammunition.

returns.description: The held weapons, empty when not spawned.

functions.name: getInventory
functions.description: Returns the selected weapon and the held weapons.

returns.description: The inventory, or null when not spawned.

functions.name: setInventory
functions.description: Atomically replaces the whole inventory of a living player in one state revision. Without selected, the first entry becomes equipped; an empty list holsters. Duplicate weapons and more than seven items are rejected without changing the current inventory.

parameters.name: weapons
parameters.description: Complete new inventory, at most seven items. Missing ammunition gets the giveWeapon defaults.

type.name: { weaponId: number; loaded?: number; reserve?: number }[]

returns.description: False when the player is not alive, an item repeats, more than seven items are supplied, or selected is not in the new inventory.

functions.name: addItem
functions.description: Adds one item, or adds its ammunition or throwable count to a weapon already held.

parameters.name: loaded
parameters.description: Rounds or count to add; defaults like giveWeapon.

parameters.name: reserve
parameters.description: Reserve rounds to add; defaults to 0.

returns.description: False for a dead player or a full inventory.

functions.name: removeItem
functions.description: Without count removes the item; with count takes that much and removes the item once none is left.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Rounds or throwables to take, reserve first.

returns.description: False when the weapon is not held.

functions.name: getCombatState
functions.description: Returns the server combat snapshot of this player.

returns.description: The snapshot, or null when the player has none.

symbols.name: Vehicle
symbols.description: A server car. The server owns engine, damage, seats and terminal state; the client chosen as simulation controller reports native physics and damage.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a handle for an existing vehicle; use Vehicle.spawn to create one.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this vehicle for logging.

returns.description: The vehicle ID and model.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Fires vehicleDestroy, then removes the vehicle from every client.

returns.description: False when it no longer exists.

functions.name: getController
functions.description: Returns the player whose client simulates this vehicle.

returns.description: The controller, or null.

functions.name: getDriver
functions.description: Returns the current-life occupant of seat 0.

returns.description: The driver, or null.

functions.name: getOccupant
functions.description: Returns the current-life occupant of a seat.

returns.description: The occupant, or null.

functions.name: getOccupants
functions.description: Returns the occupant of every seat.

returns.description: One entry per seat, null when empty.

functions.name: getDoors
functions.description: Returns each seat's door target, from 0 closed to 1 open.

returns.description: One entry per seat.

functions.name: getDamageState
functions.description: Returns the controller's native damage snapshot.

returns.description: The snapshot, or null before the first report or while repair awaits a fresh report.

functions.name: setTransform
functions.description: Sets the authoritative pose; the simulation controller applies it before it reports again.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: New position; three numbers are accepted too.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: Heading in radians or a quaternion; keeps the current rotation when omitted.

parameters.name: velocity
